phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked Document AI, custom NER, Textract, and structured information extraction sources.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Config contracts, memory bootstrap, docs/naming/structure audits, maps, boards, workspace snapshot, grounding, evaluator, timer check, and diff whitespace checks were run.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Evaluator returned ready_to_close. Follow-up ideas were recorded as future improvements, not blocking gaps.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.notes: Completed by the final close-out commit and push.

bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: Timing was not started at phase boundaries. Main cost is governance propagation across memory, requirements, specs, prompts, and docs.
improvement_candidates: Create a governance scaffold generator for repeated durable-principle changes.
Later promote repeated structuring jobs into deterministic extractors or validated skills.
